title: A counterexample to Scottish Book Problem 155
abstract: A Lean proof that there are real Banach spaces X and Y and a bijection U from X to Y which preserves every pairwise distance on every closed ball of radius one quarter while failing to be a global isometry. This gives a counterexample to Scottish Book Problem 155.

informal.ScottishBook155.claim14: There exist real Banach spaces and a bijection between them that preserves all pairwise distances on each closed ball of radius one quarter but is not a global isometry.
